body.name: Homogeneous fluctuation state evolution
body.construction: For each primitive row \(\xi\), evaluate \(\dot{\mathfrak R}_T[\delta_\xi-P_\xi]\) by ordinary differentiation on the open all-active domain \(\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\), then evaluate \(I_T(\xi)=\phi_T(\xi;P_\xi)-M_T+P_\xi[\dot\phi_T(\widetilde\xi;P_\xi)[\delta_\xi-P_\xi]]\) and set \(\Gamma_T=P_\xi[I_T(\xi)I_T(\xi)^{\top}]\). Augment this moment influence with \(f(Y_0,X)-P_{0X}f\), for \(f\in\mathcal F_{0X,T}\), to obtain the single Gaussian experiment \(\mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}\); its displayed covariance formula supplies all moment, initial empirical-process, and cross-block covariances. For \(Q\in\mathcal K\), brackets \([\cdot]_Q\) evaluate this same recursion and covariance at the model index; no separately sampled Gaussian or initial-law object is introduced.
